message: We've all got that one friend who panics at the slightest hint of a blackout, right? I used to be that friend until I learned how to prepare ahead of time. The Red Cross has some fantastic tips on what to do during a power outage, from keeping your food safe to staying comfortable. A little preparation goes a long way, and it’s nice to know what to expect when the lights go out. Have you ever been caught off guard during a blackout?
